queries_run: Celestica market share gaining 2026 hyperscaler ODM competition

findings.claim: 10-K FY2025 指出 CCS 競爭仍非常激烈，資料中心支出集中於大型雲端/AI 客戶，導致 EMS 積極競標、ODM 加強搶份額。
findings.excerpt: resulting in aggressive bidding from EMS providers and increased competition from ODMs as they attempt to gain greater share in this market.

findings.claim: 10-K 列名競爭對手含 EMS（Benchmark、Flex、Hon Hai、Jabil、Plexus、Sanmina）、ODM（Quanta、Wiwynn、Accton）及 OEM（Arista、Cisco）。
findings.excerpt: Our ODM competitors provide product design capabilities and manufacturing services and include Quanta Computer Inc., Wiwynn Corporation, and Accton Technology Corp.

findings.claim: Celestica 8-K 宣布取得第三家超大規模客戶的 1.6T 交換器平台設計與製造案，2027 開始放量。
findings.excerpt: Celestica has been awarded the program for the design and manufacturing of the 1.6 terabyte switching platform with a third hyperscaler customer. The HPS program is expected to begin ramping production in 2027.

competitive_share_entrants.note: 未找到具名競爭對手被取代的一手來源；第二方部落格稱客戶回流 Celestica 但未核原文。

clues.claim: Q2 2026 財報摘要稱客戶因 Celestica 複雜產品爬坡能力而將生產移回，並有十個 1.6T 專案進行中（二手部落格，未核原文）。
